overall_assessment: Anonymization works well for UiT's current layouts (2019-2025): the semester label and exam hand-in/hand-out dates go, nothing else is touched, and no personal data appears in any of the 13 random controls. The one real gap is the 2008-2011 English-language layout, where the closing timetable block begins 'Lectures Autumn 2008' rather than 'Undervisning Høst 2008' and survives with lecturer names glued to their roles (3 published plans in data/processed/course_plans.RDS: SVF-3904, HIF-3022, STA-3003). The 'name_like' flags are false alarms (reference authors, 'Thorvald Stoltenberg Seminar', place names).

findings.description: Staff name (course coordinator) is left in course_plan. In the 2008-2011 English page layout, the closing timetable block keeps teachers glued to their role and title ('Kursansvarlig[navn]'). A search of data/processed/course_plans.RDS finds the same leak in two more published UiT plans: HIF-3022 2008 ('ForeleserF.aman.John OveLorentz ForeleserF.aman.MartinKrämer') and STA-3003 2008 ('ForeleserF.aman.[navn]', 'Ansvarlig lederF.aman.[navn]').
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In .anon_uit() (R/anonymize.R), the last rule removes the timetable block only when it starts with 'Undervisning (?:Høst|Vår|Haust) \d{4}'. English pages head it 'Lectures Autumn 2008' (the generic semester rule later removes 'Autumn 2008' and leaves 'Lectures First meeting: ...'), so the block survives. The glued 'RoleTitleName' form also escapes the generic role+name regexes, which need whitespace between role and name.

findings.evidence: Samling 4: Spesialisering 17-19. September 2008 Ansvarlig enhet Ressurssenter for undervisning, læring og teknologi (Result)
findings.description: In the 2008-2011 Norwegian layout, the timetable-block rule removes everything to the end of the text, including the closing 'Ansvarlig enhet <unit>' line. Organisation names are metadata that must be kept, and the current layouts and the English 2008 pages (e.g. SVF-3904) keep them. All four Norwegian 2008 pages in the packet lose the line (BED-6001, BED-2017, STV-2010, PED-3025).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In .anon_uit(), stringr::str_remove('(?s)(?:^|\n)Undervisning (?:Høst|Vår|Haust) \d{4}.*$') runs to the end of the text with '.*$' and does not stop before 'Ansvarlig enhet'.
findings.suggested_fix:
End the block rule at a lookahead: '(?s)(?:^|
)Undervisning (?:Høst|Vår|Haust) \d{4}.*?(?=
?Ansvarlig enhet|
?Responsible unit|\z)'. If the unit sits on the same line, also insert the line break it needs.

findings.evidence: re-sit examination for students who fail early in the Spring semester 2009
findings.description: Some semester labels with a year and some dated deadlines in free-text fields stay: 'Spring semester 2009' (a semester label with a year; the generic season rule seems to miss the 'Spring semester YYYY' word order), 'Søknadsfrist 15. mai 2019' and 'Kull 2019 har studiested Bodø' (HEL-6308), and the session dates '28-30. nov. 2007 ... 17-19.september 2008' inside BED-6001's Undervisningsform. These are administrative dating, not personal data. Impact is low.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: In the generic semester/date handling (.season_regex usage in R/anonymize.R), the English 'Spring semester 2009' form with the year after 'semester' is apparently not covered, and the generic rules do not target day-month-year deadlines after 'Søknadsfrist'.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the semester-label rule to '(?i:spring|autumn|fall)[ \t]+semester[ \t]+\d{4}', and in .anon_uit() remove the year from the 'Søknadsfrist' value ('(?m)^(Søknadsfrist\n[^\n]*?\d{1,2}\.[ \t]*\p{L}+)[ \t]+\d{4}' -> '\1'). Leave session schedules as they are unless the spec counts them as administrative.
